text:
maria.chen: Heads up — p99 token-level latency on the tokenflow dashboard spiked in eu-west-1 around 08:14 UTC. TTFT tail jumped ~80% for longer prompts. https://grafana.redwood/d/tokenflow/panel/123 :eyes:

aj: saw it, digging. tokens/sec looks steady overall but GPU util on a subset of hosts jumped to 98%. suspect a hot-shard causing queuing.

lee_ops: Node-level backlog on gw-eu-3, queue_size metric up from ~10 -> 600 over ~3m. network_retransmits also ticked. sample log: `trace=7c1a... req_id=tx-42 model=redwood-ql-14b-v2 shard=3`

zach: quick PromQL I used to verify p99: ```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, instance))
```
That lines up with the panel.

maria.chen: alert currently is `token_ttft_p99 > 1200` with `for: 5m` (global). Proposal: scope alerts by region/shard and make transient tolerance:
```yaml
alert: TokenTTFTHigh_EU
expr: token_ttft_p99{region="eu-west-1"} > 1800
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/tokenflow-eu
```
This avoids paging for short autoscale blips but keeps SLO guardrails.

aj: i don't love widening the threshold long-term. can we instead add a suppression window around maintenance/autoscale events and add per-shard alerts?

lee_ops: also found something else — two pods were pinned to `variant=quantized-v1` and the fallback to `variant=cpu-fallback` didn't trigger due to label mismatch. opened infra bug #1543. if fallback had worked we'd have less tail.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-78 (tokenflow p99 spike, eu-west-1) — assigned to @oncall-eu.

maria.chen: action list: aj -> update alert (short-lived change), lee -> cordon gw-eu-3 and drain affected pods, zach -> add per-shard p99 panel and a tokens/sec heatmap slice. i'll own the post-incident cost calc.

zach: for dashboard slice: suggestion to add a column for `shard` + `model_variant` and a heatmap using `sum by (shard, le) (rate(token_latency_bucket[5m]))`. gives quick hot-shard spotting.

aj: i'll open a tiny PR to change the alert with the new expr + `for: 10m` and add a `suppression: autoscale=true` annotation. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/3892

lee_ops: cordoned gw-eu-3, started pod redistribution. queue_size dropping. will keep monitoring.

maria.chen: nice. zach, can you also add a dashboard link to the alert annotations (so on-call has direct context)?

zach: yep — adding `panelId=456` to the alert annotations and a small runbook snippet.

aj: quick cost note — if we decide to permanently increase reserved GPU capacity in eu-west-1 to reduce tail, ballpark +$6k/mo for a 10% uplift (depends on instance mix). include that in the followup.

maria.chen: perfect. i'll summarize and close INC-2026-78 after we confirm tail subsides for 30m. thanks all :thumbsup:
